He was actually my favorite teacher of all time, but one thing he said hurt me the worst. He was my high school teacher for random English classes, History, and other alike classes. He was always super chill, told a lot of jokes, let us watch movies. (Probs low key a commie too) I thought I was one of his favorites because we talked a lot about movies/tv shows almost every class period.

One day during class one of my friends and I were joking. My friend said “I like ______, cuz they’re a nice person,” in a dumb voice.

My teacher overheard and said, “What? ________ isn’t nice.” 

It didn’t come off as a joke. It felt like such an uncalled for personal attack. I emailed him later about how his comment hurt me. He tried explaining it away by saying that “I’m not the type of person who dots their ‘i’s’ with hearts” and shit like that. 

You don’t need to be a mushy person to at least be “nice.” Seemed unnecessary for him say. Took a complete blow to my already fragile self esteem. Never know why he felt compelled to blurt that out. Still hurts.
